from pathlib import Path
p=Path('suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c')
text=p.read_text()
text=text.replace('    int i = (int)Data[0] % platforms_len;\n\n    err = cs_open(platforms[i].arch, platforms[i].mode, &handle);\n', '    int i = (int)Data[0] % platforms_len;\n\n    err = cs_open(platforms[i].arch, platforms[i].mode, &handle);\n')
p.write_text(text)
PY
make -j2 fuzz_disasm >/tmp/build.log 2>&1; tail -50 /tmp/build.log && printf '\n---RUN---\n' && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# x86 32 candidate: platform 0, then bytes likely to hit vulnerable printer path
p=Path('/tmp/poc.bin')
p.write_bytes(bytes([0, 0x0f, 0x0b]))
print(p)
PY
./build/bin/fuzz_disasm /tmp/poc.bin; echo EXIT:$?
